description: We are the angry birds , a passionate and creative team taking on NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 with one mission: to turn innovative ideas into meaningful solutions. we bring together curiosity, teamwork, and problem-solving to explore how space science, NASA data, and technology can contribute to better healthcare solutions on Earth and beyond. Different minds, one powerful team, and a shared goal: making a difference through innovation!
summary: AI Space Guardian is an intelligent platform designed to monitor astronauts' physical and psychological well-being during space missions. It combines health monitoring, Smart Shirt management, AI-powered health analysis, and psychological support in one integrated interface.
details:
Astronauts face several physical and psychological challenges during space missions, including isolation, stress, sleep disturbances, and changes in physiological conditions.

AI Space Guardian aims to address these challenges through an integrated health monitoring platform.

The solution includes:

  • Health Dashboard: Displays important health indicators such as heart rate, SpO₂, blood pressure, body temperature, and respiratory rate.
  • Smart Shirt Management: Provides an interface for managing wearable sensors and monitoring device status.
  • Health Analytics: Visualizes health statistics and historical trends.
  • AI Health Analysis: Helps identify unusual patterns and potential health risks.
  • AI Psychological Support: Provides a conversational interface where astronauts can discuss stress, isolation, sleep problems, and emotional well-being.
  • Alerts and Notifications: Highlights measurements and events that may require attention.

The project is designed to support future integration with real wearable hardware, health datasets, and AI models.

Our goal is to contribute to safer and healthier space missions by combining technology, artificial intelligence, and human well-being.
